lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaZr₂ (Ca₂Zr₄ per cell) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with six atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Ca centers 12 Zr neighbors and Zr centers 12 neighbors (4 Ca, 8 Zr), both described as close-packed-like local arrangements, with distances of 3.2694–3.3215 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Zr 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ca and Zr polyhedra.
